custom_logic_notes: EA places both a BuyStop at current Ask and a SellStop at current Bid every tick if no matching pending order exists. This is a breakout/straddle strategy: whichever direction price moves, the stop order triggers. TrailingStop is defined but NEVER CALLED from OnTick — this is a critical bug. The trailing logic has calculation errors: for buy positions when CurrentSL > Priceopen, it computes sl = bid - ValidBuy (which doubles the distance) instead of sl = ValidBuy. Similarly for sell positions when CurrentSL < Priceopen, it computes sl = ask + ValidSell (doubling the distance). Duplicate margin checks (lines 60-70) are redundant. The TrailingStop function iterates positions from PositionsTotal() down to 0 inclusive, which is an off-by-one (should be PositionsTotal()-1).
